originalTitle: Was There Any Sign ADT Stock Would Run?

content:

Shares of ADT (ADT) climbed 30.2% in the three months from July 31 to October 29, 2026, compared to a 3.3% gain for the S&P 500. The period ended in a takeover, as ADT announced that day that Thrive Holdings agreed to buy the home-security company for $10 a share in cash. Sales growth offered little warning of a deal, as revenue rose 2.0% in the June quarter. So what had ADT already told its owners before those three months began?

ADT Reported Cash Growing Far Faster Than Sales

ADT’s reports on its first two quarters of 2026 both showed cash rising much faster than revenue. On April 30, the company announced a 37% first-quarter increase in operating cash flow , the money the business brings in after paying its running costs. Revenue in that quarter, which ended in March, grew less than 1%.

The July 30 report showed a similar pattern. Operating cash flow climbed 18% in the quarter ended in June, once again running far ahead of sales. Management called cash generation a highlight again during the earnings call that day. ADT also returned $684 million to shareholders through share repurchases and dividends over the first half of 2026, and it raised its full-year outlook.

Cash that outruns sales leaves a company to decide how to use it. Tesla makes a contrast: it holds $45.4 billion in cash, yet has never made a free-ride offer for families that the Big Story estimates would cost about $340 million. Read Trefis Big Story : Musk’s Massive Marketing Miss Cost $10 Trillion .

The share price did not follow the cash higher. ADT stock declined 2.9% in the six months to July 31. A reader watching cash rise as shares slipped had a reason to look closer. However, both reports described a business producing cash, not a sale, and they look like signs of a takeover only in hindsight.

All Of ADT’s Three-Month Gain Came On October 29

ADT stock rose 33% on October 29, the day the deal was announced. Before then, the shares had dropped about 20% from the start of the three-month period, reaching a low close of $6.08 on September 30. Even after a 7.9% rise on October 28, the day before, the stock remained below its starting price. An owner who bought based on the summer cash figures waited through that decline before the offer arrived.

Behind the share price, ADT generated more cash in the year to June 2026. Free cash flow, the money remaining after paying for investment in the business, reached $1.61 billion in the four quarters to June 2026, up from $1.38 billion a year earlier. That figure equaled 31.2% of revenue, compared with 16.9% at Allegion, a peer.

Cash generation continued to grow in the latest quarter. ADT reported free cash flow of $541 million for the three months ended in June, against $423 million a year earlier. Management expects adjusted free cash flow, the company’s own measure, to grow about 30% in 2026. It also anticipates higher cash taxes and cash interest in 2027, with each probably a $50 million to $100 million headwind.

For anyone buying the stock today, the price already sits near the takeover offer. Shares closed at $9.87 on October 29, just below the $10 a share offered. If the deal closes, a buyer at $9.87 gains only about 1%, whatever ADT’s free cash flow for the quarter ended in September shows when the company reports on November 3, 2026. A year earlier, that figure was $339 million.

chineseTitle: 有任何迹象表明 ADT 股票会上涨吗？

ADT (ADT) 的股价在 2026 年 7 月 31 日至 10 月 29 日的三个月内上涨了 30.2%，而标准普尔 500 指数则上涨了 3.3%。这一时期以收购结束，ADT 当天宣布 Thrive Holdings 同意以每股 10 美元现金收购这家家庭安全公司。销售增长几乎没有预示着达成交易，六月份季度的收入增长了 2.0%。那么，在这三个月开始之前，ADT 已经告诉其所有者什么了？

ADT 报告现金增长远远快于销售额增长

ADT 2026 年前两个季度的报告均显示现金增长速度远快于收入增长速度。 4 月 30 日，该公司宣布第一季度运营现金流增长 37%，即该业务在支付运营成本后获得的资金。截至 3 月份的该季度收入增长不到 1%。

7 月 30 日的报告也显示了类似的模式。截至 6 月份的季度，运营现金流增长 18%，再次远远领先于销售额。管理层在当天的财报电话会议上再次称现金生成为一大亮点。 ADT 还通过 2026 年上半年股票回购和股息向股东返还 6.84 亿美元，并上调了全年预期。

现金超过销售额时，公司需要决定如何使用它。特斯拉则与之形成鲜明对比：该公司持有 454 亿美元现金，但从未向家庭提供免费乘车优惠，而 Big Story 估计该优惠将花费约 3.4 亿美元。阅读 Trefis 大故事：马斯克的大规模营销失误导致损失 10 万亿美元。

股价并没有随着现金走高。截至 7 月 31 日的六个月内，ADT 股价下跌了 2.9%。随着股价下跌，看到现金上涨的读者有理由进一步观察。然而，这两份报告都描述了一家产生现金的企业，而不是销售，而且只有事后看来，它们才像是被收购的迹象。

ADT 三个月的涨幅全部来自 10 月 29 日

10 月 29 日，也就是交易宣布的当天，ADT 股价上涨了 33%。在此之前，该股自三个月以来已下跌约 20%，于 9 月 30 日触及 6.08 美元的低收盘价。即使在前一天 10 月 28 日上涨 7.9% 后，该股仍低于其起始价格。一位根据夏季现金数据购买的业主在报价到来之前等待了价格下跌。

在股价上涨的背后，ADT 在截至 2026 年 6 月的一年中产生了更多现金。自由现金流（支付业务投资后剩余的资金）在截至 2026 年 6 月的四个季度中达到 16.1 亿美元，高于一年前的 13.8 亿美元。这一数字相当于收入的 31.2%，而同行 Allegion 的这一比例为 16.9%。

最新季度现金产生量继续增长。 ADT 报告截至 6 月份的三个月自由现金流为 5.41 亿美元，而去年同期为 4.23 亿美元。管理层预计调整后的自由现金流（公司自己的衡量标准）到 2026 年将增长约 30%。它还预计 2027 年现金税和现金利息将增加，每一项都可能带来 5000 万至 1 亿美元的阻力。

对于今天购买该股票的任何人来说，价格已经接近收购要约。 10 月 29 日，该股收盘价为 9.87 美元，略低于每股 10 美元的发行价。如果交易完成，无论 ADT 在 2026 年 11 月 3 日发布财报时显示的 9 月结束季度的自由现金流如何，价格为 9.87 美元的买家仅获得约 1% 的收益。一年前，这一数字为 3.39 亿美元。
